name: FNAL-E-0531
full_name: Fermilab Experiment E531, hybrid emulsion charm experiment
summary: Fermilab E531 combined nuclear emulsions with electronic reconstruction to observe neutrino-produced charmed particles and measure their decay properties, advancing techniques later used for tau-neutrino detection.
detection_principle: Electronic trackers located neutrino interactions in emulsion modules. Microscopy resolved detached charm-decay vertices, while magnetic tracking, time-of-flight and calorimetry helped identify particles and reconstruct charm species.
